policy.authoritative_source: Poko's official FX-Clover blog / official video content

sources.title: エントリーポイントは基礎の集合体【ポコニカル】

claims.claim: Poconical is presented for GBPJPY.
The presented Poconical setup is short-only.
An M5 W-top right-shoulder entry is explicitly presented.
Pulling price into resistance, preferably from H1 or higher, is part of the entry context.
MA perfect order and Granville context are used as supporting conditions.
Wait for a W-top or head-and-shoulders right-shoulder formation area.
Reverse FR 38.2 is used to estimate a right-shoulder area and bearish-candle confirmation is described.
For a W-top example, stop placement is anchored to the left shoulder.
FE targets are used for staged / split exits.

sources.notes: The article also stresses environment recognition and says Fibonacci values are guides, not stand-alone entry rules.
sources.automation_impact: M5 can be tagged as officially used, but M5-only must remain a design requirement unless stronger official evidence establishes exclusivity. FR 38.2 must not be treated as a universal hard trigger.

sources.title: ポコニカル分析１分と５分

claims.claim: Official examples cover both M1 and M5 execution structures.
Higher-timeframe environment recognition precedes lower-timeframe execution.
An M1 head-and-shoulders right-shoulder short example is shown.
The M1 example uses the left shoulder as the stop anchor.
FE 161.8 and FE 261.8 are shown as split take-profit references in the M1 example.

sources.automation_impact: Do not describe M5 as the only execution timeframe in official Poconical doctrine. The current system may still mandate M5 as a design choice.

sources.title: Wフィボナッチで反発をみる

claims.claim: An M5 execution example is explicitly presented.
Multiple FR levels and higher/lower timeframe overlap are used as confluence.
A bearish candle confirmation at an FR reaction is used in the example.
A mini W-top example places the stop at the left shoulder.
FE 161.8 and 261.8 are used as take-profit references in examples.

sources.automation_impact: Supports confluence and left-shoulder stop logic, but does not establish a universal machine threshold for FR overlap.

sources.title: FX学習の成果は【ジワジワ】現れて自信を育てる

claims.claim: Higher-timeframe right-shoulder context can be refined with a lower-timeframe right-shoulder formation.
An M5 right-shoulder example uses reverse FR 38.2 confluence.
A short entry example uses a bearish confirmed break of DiNapoli 3-3.

sources.automation_impact: Supports nested formation + DMA3-3 confirmation concepts, but exact AND/OR logic remains unresolved.

sources.title: FX 波が見せる変化のサイン【ポコニカル勉強会60】

claims.claim: Execution may be evaluated on M5 or M1 in the described material.
Right-shoulder formations are repeatedly combined with DMA3-3 and other context.
DMA3-3 body-break exit is presented as an exit option alongside FE targets.

sources.automation_impact: Confirms that M5-only is not an official universal restriction. System M5-only remains DESIGN_TIMEFRAME_CONFIGURATION_USER_CONFIRMED.

sources.title: FX フォーメーションと移動平均線どちらが重要？

claims.claim: MA context is emphasized as background to formation entries.
MA-sand / poor-room contexts are highlighted as situations where entries may be unattractive.

sources.automation_impact: Supports keeping obstacle-MA / room-to-target as a real concept, but numeric thresholds remain unverified and must stay manual/research-only.

sources.title: チャート設定【ＤＭＡ３の３】について

claims.claim: DMA3-3 is used to read transitions between impulsive and corrective phases in trend-following setups.
The recurring structure is described as thrust, correction into a sloping MA, then renewed thrust.

sources.automation_impact: Useful for state-machine semantics, but does not by itself define a numeric DMA distance threshold.

sources.title: トレード前の準備について

claims.claim: Later material distinguishes Poconical from another method and describes Poconical as using Fibonacci context.

sources.automation_impact: Supports retaining Fibonacci as a Poconical component while avoiding hard-coding a single FR value as a universal trigger.

still_unresolved: middle-range exact start/end and numeric definition
right-shoulder high/low exact comparison rule and numeric threshold
universal AND/OR logic for all confluences
FE anchor selection rule in every setup
whether 261 or 261.8 is canonical in every context
DMA applied price if not explicit in primary setup documentation
